acceptance: every signed authority object has a material-field mutation matrix
structurally valid single-field mutations invalidate the original signature
all applicable language runners agree on decision, stage, and stable code
cross-type and cross-profile reinterpretation attempts reject
downgrade, rotation, revocation, and migration policy is explicit
property seeds and minimized counterexamples are preserved
invariants: signatures are unusable across every bound domain dimension
semantically distinct authority types cannot share an accepted signed meaning
unknown versions and profiles fail closed without fallback
rejected mutations create no reference-ledger effect
Cloud statements cannot revoke cryptographic rights
v1 objects remain v1 and are never rewritten in transit
stop_conditions: a material authority dimension is not cryptographically bound
equivalent implementations reject at different semantic stages or codes
an unknown version or profile falls back to an older interpretation
rotation or revocation depends on an unverifiable Cloud assertion
a rejected mutation changes reference-ledger state
a v1 preimage changes without an ADR and explicit version migration
